title: Harmony reports a loss-of-life incident at Mine Waste Solutions Plant; outlines group-wide safety actions
summary: The post Harmony reports a loss-of-life incident at Mine Waste Solutions Plant; outlines group-wide safety actions appeared first on Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited .
body_markdown:
**Johannesburg. Wednesday, 18 November 2026.** Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited (“Harmony” and/or “the Company”) deeply regrets to report a loss of life following an incident at its Mine Waste Solutions plant in Stilfontein on Monday, 16 November 2026.


The employee reported exposure to chemical fumes during acid treatment activities. Tragically, the employee subsequently passed away in hospital on Tuesday, 17 November 2026. The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR) and other relevant stakeholders have been notified and an investigation is underway.


Our sincere condolences go to the employee’s family, friends, and colleagues. We are providing support, including trauma counselling, to all those affected.


A loss of life is unacceptable. We are:


- Improving critical control verification to prevent loss of life at all workplaces.
- Sharing and applying the findings of both investigations across every operation.
- Strengthening ownership and accountability, assurance, hazard identification and workplace examinations throughout the Group.


“It is with profound sadness that we report this loss of life. Effective safety relies on executing the right controls every shift, in every workplace, without exception. We are working closely with the DMPR and our stakeholders to understand what happened, apply the lessons across all our operations and prevent a recurrence. Zero harm demands unwavering attention and accountability from every leader in Harmony,” said Beyers Nel, Chief Executive Officer of Harmony.


Ends.
